runners_data.name: Vincenzo Peruggia
runners_data.note: Front runner returning from 249-day layoff with poor recent trainer form, needs to lead but may lack peak fitness

runners_data.name: Kanishka
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with headgear change after recent Redcar fourth, quick turnaround suggests connections are happy with his condition

runners_data.name: Comic Hero
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist ridden by Murphy for top trainer Balding, won last time out and thrives when allowed to come from behind

runners_data.name: Strength Of Spirit
runners_data.note: Another hold-up horse off 254-day break, strong recent form before the layoff and Burke stable in decent form

runners_data.name: Utmost Good Faith
runners_data.note: Front runner with first-time headgear and solid recent form, needs to lead but headgear suggests improvement expected

races.paceDynamic: Vincenzo Peruggia and Utmost Good Faith will clash for the early lead, with both horses showing prominent tendencies and needing to be on the pace. This creates an honest gallop over the mile trip, particularly on testing ground that will sap energy from the front pair. The remaining quartet all possess hold-up styles, meaning they can sit off the pace battle and conserve energy for a finishing effort. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — the pace is genuine and the field will be strung out, allowing closers to pick up the pieces.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Vincenzo Peruggia and Utmost Good Faith engage in a pace duel early.
scenarios.body: The front pair weaken in the final furlong on testing ground, allowing the closers to surge past with fresher legs. Comic Hero and Kanishka benefit most from this strong gallop.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front runner survives duel
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders gets a slight edge and kicks clear approaching the final furlong.
scenarios.body: Utmost Good Faith's recent form edge allows him to see off Vincenzo Peruggia and hold on despite the testing conditions. The pace wasn't quite strong enough to fully collapse.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent horse splits difference
scenarios.trigger: If Monoceros can position just behind the leaders without getting embroiled in the pace battle.
scenarios.body: The Jardine runner gets the perfect trip tracking the pace battle before striking in the final two furlongs. His recent third at Ripon suggests he's ready to strike.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go too fast early and tie up badly in the testing conditions.
scenarios.body: The front pair stop dramatically, creating a muddling pace scenario where tactical speed wins over pure stamina. This unlikely scenario could suit any runner with finishing pace.

watchPoints.text: Vincenzo Peruggia could set fractions too fast after a long break, compromising both leaders' chances
Monoceros faces fitness questions after 191 days off despite Jardine's solid recent record
Kanishka's quick seven-day turnaround could indicate either sharp form or desperation from connections
Comic Hero's booking of Oisin Murphy suggests serious stable confidence in the hold-up horse's chances
Utmost Good Faith's first-time headgear application could provide the edge needed to survive the pace battle

races.paceDynamic: Goldmoyne will dictate from the front as the only confirmed leader, with five prominent runners (Midnight Gun, Golden Mind, Al Arbeed, Gweedore, Royal Zabeel, A War Eagle, Bellarchi) creating significant congestion behind him. This setup creates a moderate pace early before intensifying when the prominent pack jostle for position turning for home. The lack of genuine early pace pressure on Goldmoyne, combined with soft ground that can blunt finishing kicks, strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can secure good positions early.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Goldmoyne gets an uncontested lead and the prominent pack gets caught up in traffic
scenarios.body: The leader builds an unassailable advantage while the quality horses behind struggle to get clear runs in the congested pack. Soft ground makes it harder for hold-up horses to pick up the pieces.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pack Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If one of the quality prominent runners secures the ideal pitch just behind Goldmoyne
scenarios.body: The winner tracks the leader before moving smoothly to challenge, with class telling as the well-positioned runner has enough left to repel late challengers. Traffic victims emerge behind.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Swoop
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack goes too hard trying to get positioned and compromises each other
scenarios.body: The early pace becomes unsustainable as seven horses fight for forward positions, setting it up perfectly for Persuasion and Jannas Journey to deliver late challenges. The pace collapses in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos and Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If multiple fallers or severe interference create an unusual race shape
scenarios.body: A messy race where the expected protagonists are compromised by the pace or traffic, allowing a horse like A War Eagle or Bellarchi to benefit from the chaos. Unlikely but possible with this much early congestion.

watchPoints.text: Watch for severe traffic problems 2-3 furlongs out when Midnight Gun, Golden Mind, Al Arbeed, Royal Zabeel and Bellarchi all try to improve position simultaneously
Monitor Goldmoyne's early fractions - if he goes too fast trying to shake off the prominent pack he could set it up for the hold-up horses
Check if A War Eagle shows any signs of needing the run after 193 days off, particularly in the closing stages
Watch for Persuasion and Jannas Journey to be niggled along early if the pace is too slow, as they need to be handy to have any chance
Observe Golden Mind's reaction to the first-time tongue-tie, particularly when asked to quicken

races.paceDynamic: Roaring Legend will take the field along as the sole dedicated front-runner, with Al Qareem and Lady Vivian likely to track him in second and third through the early stages. The pace should be genuine but sustainable over this 1m6f trip, with Mount Atlas, Kate O'Riley and Many Men settling towards the rear as natural hold-up performers. With three horses committed to racing prominently and three sitting back, the race will likely develop into a tactical affair where the front three may go too fast for their own good. This setup moderately favours hold-up horses — the genuine pace will stretch the field and create opportunities for those with finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the front three go too hard early and compromise each other's finishing kicks
scenarios.body: The pace will be strong enough to set up the race perfectly for the closers, with Mount Atlas and Many Men best placed to capitalize with their superior class and finishing ability. Kate O'Riley could also benefit despite her lower rating if the pace collapses.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front runner prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Roaring Legend dictates a more measured tempo and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: Jason Hart can use his front-running position to control the race tempo, and with recent solid form at this distance, Roaring Legend can hold off the closers. Al Qareem's prominent position gives him the best chance to chase home the leader.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent tracker strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Al Qareem or Lady Vivian can secure the perfect stalking position behind a strong pace
scenarios.body: The Burke-trained Al Qareem has the class advantage and excellent soft going form, while Lady Vivian showed smart form earlier in her career and could be primed after a break. Both can strike from prominent positions without doing too much early work.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If Roaring Legend goes too slowly early and the race becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure could see all six runners still in contention turning for home, creating a messy finish where any horse could prevail. This chaotic scenario would particularly suit Kate O'Riley who has shown battling qualities and carries the lightest weight.

watchPoints.text: Roaring Legend dictating an uncontested lead could prove decisive if allowed to control the tempo throughout
Mount Atlas and Many Men both returning from long breaks - watch for any signs of rustiness in the preliminaries
Al Qareem's early position will be crucial - needs to settle close enough to Roaring Legend without doing too much work
Lady Vivian's fitness after 185 days off the track, though Beckett's record with returning horses is solid
Watch for Kate O'Riley being produced with a late run from the back - her light weight could prove telling in soft conditions

races.paceDynamic: Almuhit is the sole confirmed front runner and will set a sustainable pace without early pressure, with prominent runners Gambino and Sportingsilvermine tracking closely behind. The bulk of the field consists of hold-up horses who will settle towards the rear and rely on finishing kicks. With soft ground favouring stamina and one uncontested leader, the pace will be steady early before quickening from the home turn. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — the pace will be genuine but not breakneck, allowing closers to time their runs perfectly in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Almuhit sets moderate fractions and the pace builds gradually from 3f out.
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up horses will have perfect positioning to unleash finishing kicks, with the soft ground aiding their late surge. Almuhit's uncontested lead creates ideal conditions for closers to pick him off in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Gambino or Sportingsilvermine can sit perfectly behind Almuhit and quicken decisively.
scenarios.body: The tracking horses avoid the early pace battle while staying close enough to strike, benefiting from following the leader without doing the donkey work. Their prominent position gives them first jump on the hold-up brigade.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Almuhit gets very soft fractions early and has enough left for the finish.
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows Almuhit to conserve energy, and the soft ground may blunt the finishing kicks of his pursuers. His recent form suggests he can stay this trip when getting an easy lead.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely or favourite contenders underperform.
scenarios.body: The even pace and stamina test of 1m6f on soft ground could suit a lightly-raced improver or horse returning from a break. Form horses may not handle the conditions or distance as expected.

watchPoints.text: Almuhit may get uncontested fractions that are too easy, allowing him to steal the race if pace judgement is wrong

Watch for Dancingwithmyself settling closer than usual given the lack of pace, Oisin Murphy may adapt tactics accordingly

races.paceDynamic: Democracy Dilemma will take the field along as the sole confirmed leader, but with six horses wanting prominent positions - Jordan Electrics, Pilgrim, Rhythm N Hooves, Tropical Storm, Eternal Sunshine, and Heavenly Heather - there will be severe early congestion behind the leader. This crowding will create an uneven pace with positional scrimmaging likely to compromise several prominent runners, while the tempo may not be strong enough to fully test the field. The hold-up horses Jer Batt and Vintage Clarets can avoid the early chaos and benefit from the likely moderate gallop, making this setup favour patient tactics over prominent positioning.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses capitalise
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent brigade get tangled up early and Democracy Dilemma sets a moderate pace
scenarios.body: The early scrimmaging compromises half the field while Jer Batt and Vintage Clarets get clean runs from the back. Their patient positioning proves decisive as they sweep past tiring front-runners.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent runner breaks clear
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent horses secures an ideal early position without interference
scenarios.body: Rhythm N Hooves or Heavenly Heather avoid the congestion and track Democracy Dilemma perfectly before striking. Their tactical advantage combined with recent form proves decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Democracy Dilemma wire-to-wire
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly searching and eliminates the prominent brigade
scenarios.body: The leader gets an easy time up front while the chasing pack gets strung out by a genuine gallop. Democracy Dilemma's stamina and lack of pressure proves decisive in this handicap company.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If the early positioning battle slows the overall tempo to walking pace
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where class and acceleration matter most over tactical positioning. The highest-rated horses benefit regardless of their usual running style.

First-time headgear on Democracy Dilemma (visor) and Gangsta Man (blinkers) could spark improvement
Robert Cowell has three runners with different tactical profiles - suggests he's confident about the race setup

races.paceDynamic: Thecoffeepoddotco is the only confirmed front runner and will lead uncontested from the gates. The prominent runners The Bell Conductor, Al Hussar, Pop Star, Curious Rover and Ziggy's Triton will settle just behind but won't pressure the leader early over this sprint trip. With such a large field of hold-up horses including Wheels Of Fire, Montezuma, Zarzyni, Arnhem, Water Of Leith, Classy Al and Woohoo tracking from the rear, the pace will be steady early before quickening dramatically in the final two furlongs. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — the uncontested leader will set a manageable gallop allowing the closers to unleash their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Thecoffeepoddotco sets a steady pace and the field bunches up turning for home
scenarios.body: The large group of hold-up horses will have plenty left in the tank for their finishing kicks. Wheels Of Fire returns to form after his recent win, while Water Of Leith's excellent recent form makes him dangerous from the rear.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent runners strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent group can get first run on the leaders without expending too much early energy
scenarios.body: Al Hussar's strong soft ground form and freshness after 155 days off makes him hard to peg back. The Bell Conductor's headgear change suggests connections expect improvement from his prominent position.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front runner holds on
scenarios.trigger: If Thecoffeepoddotco can dictate terms and the hold-up horses leave their runs too late
scenarios.body: The leader gets an uncontested lead and kicks again when the field closes, making it difficult for the closers to reel him in. His recent consistent form at this trip gives him every chance.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses sprint
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is crawling and it becomes a mad dash from the two-furlong pole
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery where any horse with a clear run can win regardless of running style. The lightweights Woohoo and Water Of Leith could benefit from the lack of early pace.
